message:
So the power went out last night, and I found myself in a funny little moment with the family group chat. My kids, scattered across the country, immediately jumped in with their own blackout survival tips. One suggested filling the bathtub with water (you never know!), while another shared the best way to charge your phone with a power bank. 

Meanwhile, I was trying to keep the mood light by sending silly memes about being ‘candle-free’ and embracing the darkness. It turned into a cozy little digital gathering, reminding me that staying connected is just as important as being prepared. 

Next time I’ll be even more ready, but I think I’ll also keep the group chat buzzing! How do you all stay connected during an unexpected power outage? 😊
